text:
kai: Heads-up: customers hitting failures on very long prompts (multi-tool chains). Failure mode looks like kv-cache mismatch when > 5k tokens. Impact low but visible. Requesting expedited patch today.
devon: can you paste failing log snippet?
kai: `RuntimeError: kv_cache length (5121) != expected (5120) at kv_manager.py:142` - repro with long prompt + tool mediator.
devon: small bounds fix available, built image `gcr.io/redwood/serving:hotfix/kv-guard-2026-03-21-1`. No model binary changes.
sophia: we should do a tiny canary before full rollout. prefer us-west + apac1 only, 3% traffic. Rollback plan?
kai: rollback is immediate image revert + traffic cut. quick commands: ``deploybot abort-canary --id=auto || deploybot rollback image gcr.io/redwood/serving:previous-stable`` and circuit-breaker if errors >= 0.8% over 5m.
oncall-bot: @oncall devon you are oncall for eng-releases - please ack.
devon: ack. I'll stand by.
sophia: ops ok for expedite if canary paced to 3% and we keep apac1 at lower weight initially. +1 from me.
devon: launching canary now: `deploybot start-canary --image=gcr.io/redwood/serving:hotfix/kv-guard-2026-03-21-1 --regions=us-west,apac1 --pct=3`
deploybot: Canary kicked off. Monitor: https://deploy.redwood.example/canary/1802601234. I will post updates here.
kai: drafting release note: "Hotfix: guard against kv-cache off-by-one on very long sequences (>5k tokens). Binary patch to serving runtime. No model change."
sophia: thresholds for abort: errors >=0.8% over 5m OR p95 latency increases by >200ms vs baseline. If one region degrades, we can pause that region and continue elsewhere.
devon: saw apac1 error bump to 0.45% at +2m, p95 unchanged. holding.
kai: can we drop apac1 to 0 traffic and keep us-west on canary? devon: yep running: `deploybot set-traffic --region=apac1 --pct=0`
deploybot: apac1 traffic set to 0%. Canary continues in us-west (3%).
sophia: good call. us-west telemetry looks flat.
devon: us-west steady at 0.02% errors, p95 +10ms. proceeding to expand to 20% in us-west only: `deploybot scale-canary --region=us-west --pct=20 --stagger=2m`
deploybot: scaling canary in us-west.
kai: monitoring dashboards: token throughput normal, errors stable.
sophia: reintroduce apac1 at 1% after 10m of us-west stability.
devon: re-adding apac1 at 1%: `deploybot set-traffic --region=apac1 --pct=1`
deploybot: apac1 at 1%. Monitoring.
kai: apac1 shows 0.03% errors now, good.
sophia: green across canary targets. recommend fast roll to stable in us-west then apac1. Need final ack from oncall/dev.
devon: final +1. executing rollforward: `deploybot promote stable --image=gcr.io/redwood/serving:hotfix/kv-guard-2026-03-21-1 --regions=us-west,apac1 --stagger=1m`
deploybot: Rollforward started. Staggering by region. Watching errors, latency, throughput.
kai: posting short note to #release-notes after verification.
deploybot: Rollforward complete. No region exceeded abort thresholds in the last 10m. Summary: us-west errors 0.02% -> 0.02%, apac1 0.45% -> 0.04% after reintroduction.
sophia: tagging release `serving@2026.03.21-kv-guard` and filing a follow-up ticket for adding long-prompt integration tests + reproduce case.
kai: will add unit + e2e test, and update changelog. thanks team :thumbsup:
devon: creating release note entry and closing ticket.
sophia: closing expedited hotfix thread. :white_check_mark:
